pairs.description: Oligomeric proanthocyanidins in grape seed extract possess antiplatelet properties and may increase bleeding risks in patients on warfarin.
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of platelet adhesion, platelet aggregation, and endothelial prostaglandin generation.

pairs.description: Concomitant use of grape seed extract and aspirin results in additive antiplatelet effects, potentially increasing bruising and bleeding episodes.
pairs.mechanism: Complementary suppression of platelet activation pathways by proanthocyanidins and cyclooxygenase-1 blockade.

pairs.description: Grape seed polyphenols can alter cytochrome P450 1A2 activity, influencing systemic clearance and metabolism of CYP1A2 substrate drugs.
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of hepatic cytochrome P450 1A2 enzymatic biotransformation by flavonoid procyanidins.
